Local speech credits

Football Chess uses Paradee for local analysis and separately generated Tom recordings for match reactions. The following components are bundled for browser speech:

  • Paradee-8M model, vocabulary and browser phoneme conversion, Sahil Mahendrakar: Apache License 2.0. The conversion table derives from Hexgrad’s Misaki project.
  • ONNX Runtime Web 1.24.3, Microsoft: MIT License and third-party notices.
  • Phonemizer.js 1.2.1, Xenova: Apache License 2.0. Its embedded eSpeak NG pronunciation engine is GPL version 3 or later.

Download pronunciation component source and build material (18.9 MB ZIP). This source archive is provided for the bundled pronunciation engine and includes its provenance and reproducibility notes. It is not fetched for speech playback.
